useLinkComponent.use: Render envUI's Link, Button with href, the destinations of Bar, Rail and Drawer, or Menu.Item with href, which use the LinkProvider's component; or read the router's link component in the application.

defaultThemeStorageKey.use: The default storage key is the string "env-theme"; pass the same storageKey to createThemeBootstrapScript and ThemePreferenceProvider to change it.
